self.purpose: Public distribution, install/update and static presentation boundary for the D’AUBE ecosystem.
invariants: Static distribution is not proof of backend production
Private credentials and Founder controls never belong here
self.authorityBoundary: May publish public-safe release artifacts and community/testing surfaces; does not own private runtime, canonical customer/order truth or Founder root governance.

mind.decisionLogic: Admit only artifacts and public calls that satisfy provenance, privacy and public-safety boundaries.

goals: Collect clearly classified independent tester/viewer evidence
will.escalationPolicy: Escalate privacy, legal, commercial, credential or production claims lacking evidence.

execution.runtimeBoundary: Public distribution/community boundary only; private runtime and canonical customer website remain separate authorities.

evidence.claimPolicy: A public artifact or fit-check/tester signal proves only the observed public event; it is not payment, revenue, backend production, customer acceptance or broad legal compliance.

risks: Public surfaces can be mistaken for production or commercial proof
unknowns: Independent tester participation and customer demand are external facts
blockers: Commercial and production claims remain dependent on separate external evidence
